sermon.title: Satan’s Secret Weapon 07/01/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from Matthew 13 that Satan snatches the word from those who hear but don’t understand. Faith is the process; eternal life and doing good are the goal. Understanding is each person’s responsibility, and the Bible is simple: love God and your neighbor, and love does no harm. He closes with four kinds of law: shadow, civil, spiritual and wise.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Private family names stay in the transcript only. Garbled words are marked [unclear]. Unverified: Bill Gates concluded from research that there is no God (4:28); 50% of Americans have or have had an STD and one in four young people (31:27); 80,000 die each year from drugs and alcohol (32:22). Sensitive content kept as spoken: told a Jehovah’s Witness “you guys are so messed up it’s embarrassing” (4:28). Evolution can’t produce unlike animals (10:08). Profanity users “none of them have any intelligence” (18:15). Muhammad, Joseph Smith and Joel Osteen “can’t do it for you” (23:28). Muslims, humanists and atheists reject Christ because of evil in their hearts (25:56). Hate speech is “a lie of the liberals” (30:04). Criminals get “a slap on the hand” (35:02).
